policy.purpose: 重要能力先设计再实施；判定及记录的唯一流程见 docs/development/repository-workflow.md#设计判定与记录。已登记 blocked-pending-design 能力命中匹配模式时，check_design_gate.py 拒绝实施。
policy.judgment_procedure: 按仓库工作流的五项判定检查本次能力与既有设计覆盖；命中后先落设计，登记 owner、designDoc、设计要点、有效匹配范围及退役条件。空模式或未登记能力不能由机器保证，仍须人工判定。
policy.approval: 先在仓库保存或修订设计文件，再将已明确方案与边界的条目标为 approved，并在 design_notes 说明裁决依据；未定部分保持 blocked-pending-design。落库不要求自动 Git 提交，提交/发布遵守用户授权。误报可凭具体产生者收窄模式并记录理由；不得只改状态绕过未完成设计。
policy.retirement: 能力实施并过验证门后，将稳定职责移交现有合同并删除该窄条目；未完成的独立范围继续登记，不把部分完成扩为整体批准。

Use actual prepared ABI/source and exact Binding slots, original source cuts, one ledger/publication/main owner and local fallback; never substitute base for effect output or replay descendants. Raw capture cannot stand in for effect output. No new state, traversal or repeated execution; hidden/forward/utility/Puppet domains keep their own qualification. Property target fallback: docs/scene/capabilities/runtime-input-property-coverage.md#property-target-fallback. Source-free quad: docs/scene/capabilities/effect-execution-coverage.md#source-free-quad. These linked contracts own the design details; this registry only routes implementation.

areas.title: Scene架构级迁移与语言执行收敛
areas.owner: Scene Session / typed programs and component owners
areas.design_notes: Existing component execution contracts: docs/scene/capabilities/render-graph-shader-coverage.md#source-channel-layout and docs/scene/capabilities/runtime-input-property-coverage.md#effect-linked-timeline. Preserve one prepared resource/value chain, clock and output; replace old admission or duplicate work in the responsible owner. Verification and limits belong to those contracts. Property target-local fallback and no-writer rebuild retirement: docs/scene/capabilities/runtime-input-property-coverage.md#property-target-fallback. Preserve other consumers rebuild marks and atomic live updates. Source-free quad dependency and hierarchy contract: docs/scene/capabilities/effect-execution-coverage.md#source-free-quad. Existing prepared sampler/input facts and nearest raster own execution; no blanket slot0 or parentless permission. Emitter numeric preparation: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#emitter-speed and #emitter-sign. Prepare finite ordered speed endpoints and shape-owned integer direction selection in the existing cold SpawnPlan; ignore unused Box sign at the original Parser while preserving other shapes and parse each used numeric field once; reuse original radial sampling/RNG and final multiplied Float birth checks. Retire arbitrary numeric permission without changing space or scheduling semantics. Periodic count contract: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#periodic-emission. Consume the existing typed cap in original EmitterState windows, one natural-usage scalar, live count scaling and carried fraction; preserve original no-cap arithmetic, clocks/RNG and value snapshots. Retire the blanket cap nil gate without moving it to playback or adding permission state. Full-capacity scheduling and early explicit/natural phase differences remain separately tracked, with no parity claim. Control point position precedence: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#control-point-position. Reuse the original CP owner for dynamic/instance replacement of ordinary definition positions across emitter and simulator consumers; keep pointer offsets additive and component origins separate. No new state, registry or space expansion. Particle CP component ownership: docs/scene/architecture/runtime-architecture.md#particle-control-point-components. Typed position, single-CP radius and two-CP endpoint consumers share original prepared plans and frame transactions. Single-CP radius prepares consumed numeric inputs once. Bounded official controls and docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#control-point-radius define single-CP radius/default/step strength and preserved-velocity scope. Moving-CP controls require prior-point transport; keep point/endpoint history in the original Simulator snapshot owner, without a parallel cache or per-particle history. Preserve the explicitly unqualified fractional blend, singular point and same-cadence explicit-birth combinations. Reuse current CP conversion and original root/child reference offsets based on actual consumer demand. No raw-flag combination admission, sample/path dispatch, new per-particle history or second CP owner. World translation ownership: docs/scene/architecture/runtime-architecture.md#particle-world-translation. Reuse the original static reference, typed current frame, child origin/birth-origin tables and batch/model owner; connect ancestor translation and creation/prewarm consistently without renderer-name permission, duplicate offsets or false parent death on freeze. Unknown child flags and unimplemented spatial consumers retain their independent boundary. Prewarm work ownership: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#prewarm-work. Charge actual entered births and predeath population only in original warmUp, keep conservative actual-population/history-capacity charge, original weighted budget and step/event/RNG sequence; stop before next step after budget exhaustion, no recorder or live-frame accounting state. Event inheritance contract: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#event-value-inheritance. Replace color-only raw-key admission with typed operations and the existing runtime event context projection of color/size/alpha. Preserve original snapshots/follow refresh, local unavailable writers and final birth checks; retire whole-template admission and duplicate initializer permission. Numerical units and repeated random-writer semantics require bounded official controls and native event-to-output verification; no sample dispatch or extra state owner.
